name: AutoBoostSEO Connector
author: Lewis

sections.description:
The AutoBoostSeo Connector plugin enables seamless integration between your WordPress site and the AutoBoostSeo platform. It automatically configures the necessary API access and permissions, allowing AutoBoostSeo to enhance your content’s SEO performance.

Key Features:

  • One-click connection to AutoBoostSeo
  • Secure API integration with proper authentication
  • SEO metadata exposure for optimization
  • Advanced content filtering capabilities
  • Performance optimization for large WordPress sites
  • Compatible with Rank Math and Yoast SEO
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/autoboostseo-connector directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. No further configuration needed – the plugin works automatically!
sections.faq:
Is this plugin secure?

Yes. The plugin only provides access to your WordPress content through proper authentication. All communications between your site and AutoBoostSeo are encrypted and secured.

Does this work with Rank Math/Yoast SEO?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with both Rank Math and Yoast SEO. It will automatically detect which SEO plugin you’re using and integrate with it.
sections.changelog:
3.4.2

  • WordPress.org Plugin Directory review compliance
  • Moved all inline scripts to enqueued admin-script.js
  • Moved inline styles to wp_add_inline_style
  • Replaced json_encode with wp_json_encode throughout
  • Added strict type comparisons (in_array with true, === instead of ==)
  • Removed @ error suppression, using proper WordPress alternatives
  • Sanitized all $_SERVER and $_POST superglobal access
  • Full i18n compliance — all user-facing strings wrapped in translation functions
  • Added file docblocks to all PHP files
  • Replaced inline onclick handlers with enqueued JavaScript
  • Used elseif instead of else if per WordPress coding standards

3.4.1

  • Fixed false positive “REST API Access” warning in connection test — no longer flags legitimate plugins (Rank Math, Application Passwords, etc.) that hook into rest_authentication_errors
  • Warning now only triggers when REST API is actually blocked, with a softer message explaining AutoBoostSEO uses authenticated requests

3.4.0

  • Improved WordPress.org compliance — all admin strings now translatable (i18n)
  • Fixed RankMath SEO score meta key for accurate score queries
  • Optimized SEO stats queries for better performance on large sites
  • Enhanced output escaping and input sanitization throughout
  • Improved security plugin warning notice with proper escaping
  • Cleaned up uninstall routine to remove all plugin data
  • Code quality improvements and consistent logging

3.3.0

  • Comprehensive connection test — now runs 11 checks (permalinks, REST API, external reachability, SSL, Application Passwords, security plugins, HTTP auth, REST API filters, caching plugins, multisite, CORS)
  • Each failed check provides a specific fix with step-by-step instructions
  • Three result states: all passed (green), passed with warnings (amber), failed (red)
  • Detects HTTP Basic Auth (.htpasswd) on staging sites
  • Detects REST API disabled by filter (e.g., “Disable REST API” plugins)
  • Detects caching plugins (WP Super Cache, W3TC, WP Rocket, LiteSpeed, etc.)
  • Warns about multisite installations with connection guidance
  • Support Diagnostics section always visible (no longer requires WP_DEBUG)
  • Diagnostics include security plugin, SEO plugin, and CORS status detection
  • Copy to Clipboard button for easy support ticket creation
